title: gate_research_out refuses a digest with no findings
intent: Pin the exit gate of the research region: a digest that parses but carries no findings is refused and routed to graceful_failure.

questions: Where is the config parsed today?
What happens to an unknown block?
Is there a typed error class already?

sections.architecture: One parse entry point, called from the CLI and from the library surface.
sections.patterns: Zod schemas per block, composed at the top level.
sections.conventions: Typed errors extend ConfigError and carry the offending key.
sections.risks: Silently dropping unknown blocks means a typo is invisible today.

artifact.reason: gate_research_out refused the digest: findings is empty
artifact.detail: The run stopped at gate_research_out: gate_research_out refused the digest: findings is empty.

expected.notes: An accepting critique is not enough: the region's exit gate is a separate check, and research.collect is never invoked. A runtime that collected the empty digest anyway would produce a fourth pinned call and fail this case.
